policy.headline: Two more updates this week, then a pause. Serious fixes still ship when they're needed.
points: Version 1.3.2 (silent updates for Windows and Linux) and version 1.4 (a stability release) are both planned for this week.
After 1.4, no more updates are planned for now. If a serious problem turns up, especially anything that could lose your data, a fix is still released as quickly as possible.
If an update isn't ready or hasn't been tested properly, it moves instead of shipping. This page says so and why.
The browser version (the website) updates as soon as a release is published. The browser zip is attached to every release.
Windows and Linux get silent updates from version 1.3.2 on. On a Mac the app tells you when an update is out and links to the download, because Apple's signing isn't paid for yet.
Windows is tested on a real PC. Linux can only be tested in a virtual environment.
notified: Press Watch on the GitHub page, then Custom, then Releases, to get an email for each release.
Add the releases feed to your feed reader.
In the desktop app, Control Panel shows when it last checked for updates and what it found.

upcoming.title: Silent updates for Windows and Linux
items: Silent auto-update for Windows and Linux (Mac stays notify-and-download)
If a silent update ever fails, the app falls back to telling you and linking to the download
upcoming.note: The first update this delivers is 1.4. Linux updating is best effort, because Linux can't be tested on real hardware.

upcoming.title: Stability release
items: No new features: fixes, testing and making things more reliable
Testing on Mac, Windows and Linux

upcoming.title: After 1.4
items: No updates are planned after 1.4 for now. Serious problems will still be fixed.
Still on the list, with no date: Now Playing covers on Windows that check every media session.

released.summary: Clipy can add events, reminders, tasks and assignments when you ask (with an optional switch to write them to Apple Calendar), tidier pop-outs and a File > Pop Out App menu, no more back-to-back Clipy tips, and an accurate storage bar in the browser.
Write to Apple Calendar and Reminders (Mac), pop-out windows for apps, Apple's on-device model for M.X.E.S., optional Now Playing cover lookup, and loading your desktop backup in the browser.
Important fix: saved data wasn't read after updating if you had folders or structured citations.
Windows fixes: full screen, tougher saving, an optional taskbar number, a taskbar menu, and troubleshooting buttons.
Command palette, tags and courses, folders as course hubs, shortcuts you can change, and a better update checker.
Citation Maker 2.0, Sketch Pad 2.0, a flash-card hotkey, and Now Playing in the taskbar clock.
Apple Calendar and Reminders (reading), Periodic Table 2.0, and a calendar in the taskbar clock.
